outcome: time to highest level of sensory block
frequency of side effects (hypotension, nausea/vomiting, respiratory depression, shivering)
cohort: 150 pregnant women undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS)
finding: The study found that intrathecal dexmedetomidine, when added to levobupivacaine, provided longer motor block and postoperative analgesia compared to fentanyl.
